name: The Art and Science of Building Molecules and Materials
description: Basics of stereochemistry, R/S-nomenclature; projection formulae; MO approaches for the stereochemical outcome of the reactions; determination of reaction mechanism; kinetic versus thermodynamic control of reactions; trapping of reactive intermediates; pharmaceutical molecules: retrosynthesis, forward synthesis and applications. Polymers: classification, synthesis, applications of silicon-based polymers, siloxanes and silanes, polysiloxanes and polysilanes. Industrial catalysis: transition metal-based industrial catalysts, 18-electron rule, types of organometallic reactions, hydrogenation, hydroformylation, Monsanto and Cativa processes, cross-coupling reactions, and Ziegler-Natta catalysis. Chemical synthesis of nanomaterials and applications.
